units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> saw a castle <he>דּוֹלֶקֶת</he> lighted.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 6:5">B. Kam. VI, 5</cite> <he>ודָלְקוּ</he> and they caught fire.
Y. Sabb. II, beg. 4ᶜ והיא דְלֵיקָה והולכת that it may continue to burn. Ib.ᵈ דְּלֵיקִין are burning.—Part. pass. דָּלוּק enkindled, burning.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11">Gen. R. s. 11</cite> <he>מצאתי אותו דָ׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 16:20">Yalk. ib. 16</cite> <he>דּוֹלֵק</he>) I found it still burning.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 7:11">Midr. Till. to Ps. VII, 14</cite> (ref. to <he>לדלקים</he> <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 7:11">ib.</cite>) <he>שלבם דָּ׳ עליהם</he> (Yalk. a. l. <he>דולק</he>) whose hearts within them are burning (with lust).—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4">Lam. R. to IV, 19</cite> [read:] <he>שהיו דולקין אחריהם מַעֲבִיּוֹת</he> (<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:2:1">Koh. R. to V, 2</cite> <he>שמשליכין דֶּלֶק אחריהם</he>) they (the Romans) sent fire after them from their engines (tormenta), v. <cite ref="P00055"><he>עָבִית</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to pursue eagerly. Lam. R. l. c. דּוֹלְקֵיהֶם של ישראל (Koh. R. l. c. רודפ׳; Midr. Till. l. c. שונאין) Israel’s persecutors.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 3:1">Orl. III, 1</cite> <he>יִדָּלֵק</he>; <he>יִּדָּלְקוּ</he> must be burnt. Ib. 2 sq.; a. fr.—Y. B. Kam. IV, 5ᶜ top <he>דרכן לִידָּלֵק</he> liable to take fire.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:1">Sabb. II, 1</cite> <he>במה מַדְלִיקִין</he> what material may be used for the Sabbath lights? Ib. 7 <he>הַדְלִיקיּ וכ׳</he> light the lamps. Y. ib. II, 4ᶜ bot.; Y. Ter. XI, 48ᵇ top <he>באה להַדְלִיק וכ׳</he> she came to get a light from a priest’s wife; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="E00130"><he>הַדְלָקָה</he></cite>.
